name: conv_window_scatter_with_mask
description: Masked convolution-window cache scatter with signature conv_window_scatter_with_mask(dst, src, dst_indices_raw, step_indices_raw). dst is [layers, cache, dim, win], src is an overlapping strided view [layers, requests, draft, dim, win], and dst_indices_raw/step_indices_raw are [requests] int32. For every request i with step_indices_raw[i] >= 0, write dst[:, dst_indices_raw[i], :, :] = src[:, i, step_indices_raw[i], :, :] using the source view's own strides. The native wrapper fills dst in place and returns that same tensor; requests with negative step indices are skipped, and dst_indices_raw/step_indices_raw/src are read-only. It raises RuntimeError unless dst is 4-D and src is 5-D. The suite exercises float32 and bfloat16 inputs, including negative-step masking.
